newsitem.title: GERMANY: DB Airbus to swing to net profit in '96 -official.
newsitem.headline: DB Airbus to swing to net profit in '96 -official.

text.p: German aircraft maker Daimler-Benz Aerospace Airbus is expected to swing to a net profit this year, gaining from the boom in the aircraft industry, a senior group official told a German newspaper.

Although the group would still post an operating loss, its net profit should be at least 10 million marks, Gustav Humbert, who heads the managment at the German Airbus partner, told German newspaper Sueddeutsche Zeitung at the weekend.
He expected that the operating business would swing to a profit next year.
But job cuts would continue reducing the workforce by about 11 percent to 13,500 by the end of next year, he said.
